summary.text: Aaron Brent is the independent candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 74, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Kevin Norwood (R).

paragraphs.text: Aaron Brent was born in Oklahoma, graduated from Chouteau High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northeastern State University in 2009 and a graduate degree from Louisiana State University in 2014.
In 2024 he ran for Oklahoma House District 74 and lost the general election to incumbent Mark Vancuren (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a former public school teacher, husband and father of two.
He named public education and higher pay for educators, civil rights, health care, and the cost of living as campaign priorities.
